Class UrlQueue

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
projetosd.UrlQueue
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Remote, UrlQueueInterface
public class UrlQueue extends UnicastRemoteObject implements UrlQueueInterface
Implementation of the UrlQueueInterface for managing a queue of URLs. Handles addition and retrieval of URLs for distributed crawling.
